title: fix(cli): agents list no longer blames the Matrix plugin for core deprecation warnings
body:
Related: #190243

## What Problem This Solves

CLI channel inventories could emit two `DEP_PLUGIN_SDK` warnings blaming the bundled Matrix plugin even though core selected its deprecated synchronous saved-auth probe.

## Change

Use the existing awaited channel-discovery API in agents list, channel capabilities, interactive removal, fallback status, and health. Provider ordering, inventory options, public synchronous compatibility APIs, and persisted credentials remain unchanged.

Retains @mushuiyu886's agents-list fix and real command-boundary regression, extends the repair to sibling callers, and strengthens the regression to prove that async saved-auth discovery actually ran. Four affected fixture mocks now preserve the real module exports; their obsolete mock-baseline allowances are removed. The dedicated 101-line allocation covers the net regression-test growth; the shared scalar budget is unchanged.

The signed baseline refresh resolves one adjacent mock-baseline deletion conflict while preserving both the PR's and main's removals. It adds no further production behavior.

## Evidence

- Reproduced both warnings through real `agents list`; the rebuilt CLI with isolated synthetic Matrix credentials then exited 0, displayed the Matrix binding, and emitted zero stderr bytes.
- Five-caller migration: 77 focused tests passed, one Windows-only skip; full build, command typecheck, and targeted lint passed before baseline refresh.
- Final partial-mock correction: all 55 affected tests passed before baseline refresh, including the health deletion case that caught the missing async export.
- Refreshed candidate: mock-export ratchet passed (6337 grandfathered factories), test-line ratchet passed (16 lines of slack), and `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh independent P0–P3 review of the complete refreshed delta found no actionable findings.
- Published head `282328c19c3d5640c122039de565753ace21487c`: [CI run 43128938831](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43128938831) completed successfully, including Node tests, both UI E2E shards, production/test types, lint, and baseline ratchets. Security checks and the enforced CI gate passed. Native hosted-proof verification accepted the exact head.

### Current local test gap

Two refreshed-candidate test launches stopped before executing tests: Vitest's bundled configuration cannot resolve `@solidjs/vite-plugin` from the shared root installation. The import already exists on main; the PR changes no package/dependency files. The retained root installation and other work were left unchanged. Published-head CI now supplies successful refreshed test/type/lint/ratchet evidence. The earlier full build remains pre-refresh evidence; the CI build-artifacts job was not selected for this diff. Earlier local results are not represented as refreshed-head local test passes.

No Matrix storage change or live homeserver is required.
